# Rx Medical Web

> Marketing agency dedicated to medical practices: websites, SEO, advertising, social media, AI agents, apps, e-mail and text marketing, and printing. Physician owned, based in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. Strategic partner of Empire Medical Training.

Contact: 1-888-599-4548, support@rxmedicalweb.com, https://rxmedicalweb.com/contact-us/

## Services

- [Medical website design](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/medical-website-design/): Custom websites for medical, aesthetic and dental practices, designed and programmed in house and built to turn visitors into patient calls.
- [Medical spa website design](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/medical-spa-website-design/): Websites and marketing for med spas, day spas and aesthetic practices, custom built to match the experience patients get when they walk in.
- [Landing pages and funnels](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/landing-pages-funnels/): One page, one treatment, one action. Landing pages built for a single campaign convert far better than sending ad traffic to your home page.
- [Mobile apps for iPhone and Android](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/mobile-apps/): Your own app in the App Store and on Google Play, with your name and your brand, so patients carry your practice in their pocket and you run it on the go.
- [Medical e-commerce](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/medical-e-commerce/): Sell skincare, supplements and other products from your practice website. We set up the store, the payments and the products.
- [EMR and patient portals](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/emr-patient-portals/): Connect your EMR's patient portal to your website, so patients find forms, appointments and refills in one place.
- [Online booking and intake](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/online-booking/): Let patients book a visit and fill in their forms from their phone, at any hour, without calling the front desk.
- [Accessibility and compliance](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/website-accessibility-compliance/): A medical website has to work for every patient and handle their information carefully. We build and audit for both.
- [Website maintenance](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/website-maintenance/): A designated team keeps your website current, secure and fast, and makes your changes within 24 to 48 hours.
- [Search engine optimization](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/search-engine-optimization/): SEO gets your practice website to appear high in the results when patients search for the procedures you offer.
- [Local SEO](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/local-seo/): Most patients choose a practice near them. Local SEO puts you on the map, with listings that are complete and correct.
- [AI search optimization](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/ai-search-optimization/): Patients now ask ChatGPT, Google's AI Overviews and other assistants which doctor to see. We work to make your practice part of the answer.
- [Pay-per-click](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/pay-per-click/): Paid search is the fastest way to the top of the results. Your ad appears when a patient searches for a service you offer.
- [Search and social advertising](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/search-engine-marketing/): In crowded markets, SEO alone may not be enough. Paid advertising on Google, Instagram, Facebook and TikTok fills the gap.
- [Reviews and reputation](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/reputation-management/): Patients read reviews before they call. We help you collect more of them, answer them well and keep your profiles accurate.
- [AI agents: chat, text and voice](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/ai-chat-messaging/): Assistants on your website, your text line and your phone that answer patients at any hour, take booking requests and hand off to your staff.
- [Social media management](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/social-media/): A dedicated team creates and maintains your social media, so your practice stays in front of patients between visits.
- [Short-form video](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/short-form-video/): Short vertical videos are how many patients first meet a doctor. We plan, film, edit and publish them for you.
- [E-mail marketing management](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/e-mail-marketing/): Stay in contact with your patients with newsletters written by physicians and sent on the schedule you choose.
- [SMS campaign management](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/sms-marketing/): Text messages get read within minutes. We plan, write, send and track your text campaigns, and keep them within the carrier and consent rules.
- [Physician content marketing](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/physician-content-marketing/): Website content, newsletters, articles and blogs written by physicians and internet writers. We do all the work.
- [Video testimonials](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/video-testimonials/): Our videographers come to your office, interview your patients and deliver a finished video for your website.
- [Lead management and CRM](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/patient-crm-automation/): Every inquiry captured, answered in minutes and followed until it becomes a booked patient. Past patients brought back automatically.
- [New service launch](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/new-service-launch/): You trained in a new procedure. Now patients need to know you offer it. We take a new service from certificate to first bookings.
- [Marketing strategy](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/marketing-strategy/): A marketing plan for your practice, built by people who know medicine and business, with a review every month.
- [Branding and graphic design](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/medical-graphic-design/): Logos, brochures, postcards and print materials that give your practice one consistent, professional image.
- [Printing and fulfillment](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/printing/): We design it, print it and ship it to your office. The same print partner that produces Empire Medical Training's materials prints yours.
- [Medical practice kit](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/medical-practice-kit/): Our most complete program: a custom website, email capture, print materials, staff training and consultation with physicians and business staff.
- [Integrations with your tools](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/integrations/): You do not have to replace your systems to work with us. What we build connects to your current tools whenever they offer an API or webhooks.
- [Analytics and call tracking](https://rxmedicalweb.com/service/analytics-call-tracking/): See which campaigns make the phone ring. One dashboard for calls, forms, bookings and what each of them cost.

## Specialties

- [Med spas and aesthetics](https://rxmedicalweb.com/specialties/med-spa-aesthetics/): Your patients choose you with their eyes first, pay out of pocket, and decide whether to return every few months. Marketing for an aesthetic practice has to win the first visit and earn the next one.
- [Dermatology](https://rxmedicalweb.com/specialties/dermatology/): A dermatology practice runs two businesses under one roof: insured medical visits with long waits and cash-pay cosmetic services. We market each on its own terms, starting with the conditions patients search for.
- [Plastic surgery](https://rxmedicalweb.com/specialties/plastic-surgery/): Plastic surgery patients research for months, compare surgeons by their galleries and ask about cost before they ever call. We build marketing that stays useful through that whole decision, from first search to booked consultation.
- [Dental practices](https://rxmedicalweb.com/specialties/dental/): Dental patients choose from a short list of nearby offices, and they ask about insurance before anything else. We market for both sides of your schedule: steady hygiene recall and the implant and cosmetic cases that take longer to decide.
- [Medical weight loss](https://rxmedicalweb.com/specialties/weight-loss/): Demand for physician-supervised weight loss is high, and so is the competition from telehealth brands. We help local practices earn that demand with marketing that respects the rules on advertising prescription medications.
- [Pain management](https://rxmedicalweb.com/specialties/pain-management/): Pain practices grow through two doors: physicians who refer and patients who search on their own, often older and often insured. We build marketing that serves both, with the care this specialty's advertising requires.
- [Hormone therapy and anti-aging](https://rxmedicalweb.com/specialties/hormone-anti-aging/): Your patients research for weeks before they call, pay out of pocket, and stay only if they understand their program. We build marketing that educates first and keeps every claim careful.
- [Family practice](https://rxmedicalweb.com/specialties/family-practice/): A primary care practice runs on full schedules and insurance panels, and many are now adding cash services such as aesthetics or weight loss. We market both sides without making your practice look like two different businesses.

## Guides

- [How to be the practice AI assistants recommend](https://rxmedicalweb.com/resources/ai-search-for-medical-practices/): A practical guide to how AI assistants and AI search summaries pick practices to mention, and the groundwork that makes yours easier to find, understand and verify.
- [You trained in a new procedure: a first-month marketing checklist](https://rxmedicalweb.com/resources/new-procedure-launch-checklist/): An ordered checklist for the first month after training, covering what to prepare, who to tell first, and how to know whether the new service is gaining traction.
- [Google Business Profile for doctors: what to fix first](https://rxmedicalweb.com/resources/google-business-profile-for-doctors/): A practical order of work for the parts of your Google Business Profile that shape how patients find, judge and contact your practice.
- [Questions to ask before you hire a medical marketing agency](https://rxmedicalweb.com/resources/questions-before-hiring-a-medical-marketing-agency/): A practical checklist for physicians and practice managers covering ownership, contracts, medical content, measurement, advertising rules, reporting and what happens when you leave.
- [Every missed call is a patient: what AI agents and text-back can do](https://rxmedicalweb.com/resources/missed-calls-and-ai-agents/): Why medical practices miss calls, what happens to those callers, and how AI agents and missed-call text-back can help within clear limits.
- [How to ask every patient for a review, the right way](https://rxmedicalweb.com/resources/asking-patients-for-reviews/): A simple, fair routine for requesting reviews from every patient, replying without revealing patient information, and staying within what review sites allow.
- [Short videos for physicians: twenty topics patients want to see](https://rxmedicalweb.com/resources/short-video-ideas-for-physicians/): Twenty short-video topics in four themes, plus practical notes on filming in one session, captions, consent and physician review of what you say on camera.
- [Your website and patient privacy: a checklist for practices](https://rxmedicalweb.com/resources/website-privacy-checklist-for-practices/): A practical walk through the places a practice website can expose patient information, with questions to bring to your vendors and your compliance counsel.
- [What a medical practice website needs in 2026](https://rxmedicalweb.com/resources/what-a-medical-website-needs-in-2026/): A practical checklist for physicians and practice managers covering speed, patient questions, booking, credentials, reviews, accessibility, structured data, physician review and measurement.
- [E-mail and text messages patients are glad to get](https://rxmedicalweb.com/resources/email-and-text-that-patients-welcome/): A practical guide to patient e-mail and SMS: getting consent, sending useful content, timing reminders, segmenting by interest, honoring opt-outs and keeping health details out of messages.
